safety_limit: Manual activation made this one owned AX window visible and its title grant active, and owned actions reached AppKit. It does not prove autonomous background-only grant resolution or general exact-window authority. Existing helper binds title declarations to an App Ref and checks App owner, not exact window identity. Directed capture Ref cannot be equated to an AX window by title or geometry alone. Earlier unresolved/discovery_incomplete remains separately documented in checkpoint-5.json.
